# /atv routing fixtures — Layer 2 (live-model smoke) test data.
#
# NOT shipped to users. Lives in testdata so it never enters the plugin tree.
# Each line: <prompt> | <expected-target>
#
# expected-target is one of:
#   skill name (must exist in the catalog) | emit:lfg | emit:slfg |
#   no-match | control:off|on|suggest | force:<skill>
#
# Layer 1 (deterministic, TestRoutingFixtures_* in Go): assert every skill
# target exists in the generated catalog, required edge cases are present, and
# no fixture points at a dangling skill.
# Layer 2 (live smoke, manual — see docs/atv-router.md): feed each prompt to a
# live /atv router, accept a top-2 match. Nondeterminism expected; not in CI.

# build intents (emit-and-stop; /lfg /slfg keep disable-model-invocation)
build me a login form with validation | emit:lfg
implement the whole feature end to end, just do it | emit:lfg
build this fast with a swarm of parallel agents | emit:slfg
ship the entire thing in parallel | emit:slfg

# planning / ideation
is this idea worth building | ce-brainstorm
help me think through the approach before coding | ce-brainstorm
what should I improve in this project | ce-ideate
turn these requirements into a technical plan | ce-plan
plan this feature | ce-plan
deepen my existing plan with more detail | deepen-plan
review this plan document for gaps | document-review

# implementation / review
do the implementation work on the existing plan | ce-work
review my code changes before I open a PR | ce-review
look at my diff | ce-review
strip the AI slop out of this code | unslop

# research / experiment loop (measurable metric — genuine autoresearch)
optimize this function's runtime in an experiment loop | autoresearch
run an autonomous experiment to hill-climb the metric | autoresearch

# bugs (systematic root-cause debugging → /investigate)
the test suite fails with a clear stack trace, why | investigate
why is this broken | investigate
this page doesn't work and I can't tell why | investigate
wtf is happening with this stack trace | investigate
this used to work and now it 500s | investigate

# browser / QA (special-cased first)
does this page actually work in the browser | test-browser
take a screenshot of the deployed site | test-browser
check the deploy visually | test-browser

# security
is this code secure | atv-security
run an owasp scan on the app | atv-security

# lifecycle / misc
what should I work on next | takeoff
land the plane | land
record a demo video of this feature for the PR | feature-video
make a meme for the changelog | meme-iq
check my atv install health | atv-doctor

# learning
capture what we just learned as a reusable pattern | ce-compound

# control commands
off | control:off
on | control:on
suggest | control:suggest
@ce-plan build a spec for auth | force:ce-plan

# no-match floor (below confidence: answer directly, show menu)
what's the weather today | no-match
tell me a joke about goats | no-match

# collision case (ambiguous "review" — must not crash)
the review looks off | ce-review
